title: Strict compact-support reduction comparison and finite coordinates
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-qcqs-compact-support-strict-reduction-comparison, there exist coefficient derived-system calculi SX and SY and a natural map beta from the completed ambient compactification image followed by SY.reduction to the native strict proper/open system built from SX.reduction. In the reductionEvaluation and nativeEvaluation coordinates, beta satisfies the finite proper/open scalar comparison identity at every level and every ambient derived input.

source.place: Strict proper/open comparison before the total inverse-limit comparison
source.note: The construction and its finite-coordinate equation are the first part of the parent node's proof.

proof.text: Choose coefficient derived-system calculi SX, SZ and SY on the source, compactification and target. Obtain the whole-system open comparison betaJ and proper comparison betaP. Define beta as betaP after completed open extension, followed by native proper image of betaJ, with the canonical functor associators.

Naturality of the native proper evaluation moves evaluation of P(betaJ) past that comparison. Substitute the proper and open finite equations, then cancel the middle SZ reduction coordinate and finiteReductionIso. comparison_factorization identifies the remaining ordered proper/open paste with the existing finite compact-support comparison.

The proved changeCoordinates_comp identity transports from finite ringed open/direct image to the intrinsic finite compact-support presentation. Naturality of the two presentation isomorphisms and their inverse laws cancel all middle coordinates. Cancel the source and target reduction isomorphisms to obtain exactly the specified equation.

theorem qcqsCompactSupport_strictReductionData :
    ∃ (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
      (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y),
    let N := SX.reduction ⋙ ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.i ⋙
      ProEtale.VaryingRing.P (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.g
    let e (n : ℕ) : N ⋙ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n ≅
        scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n ⋙
          sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft SX.reduction (compactSupportSystemEvaluation l E c n) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (SX.reductionEvaluation n)
          (sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)))
    ∃ (β : image (completed l E) c ⋙ SY.reduction ⟶ N),
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ),
        (SY.reductionEvaluation n).inv.app ((image (completed l E) c).obj K) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map (β.app K) ≫
            (e n).hom.app K =
          (finiteReductionIso l E Y n).inv.app ((image (completed l E) c).obj K) ≫
            (comparison (reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) c).app K ≫
            (finiteImageIso l E n c).hom.app
              ((pbcDerivedExtend (projection l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) X)).obj
                K) ≫
            (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
              c).map ((finiteReductionIso l E X n).hom.app K)
